clips.notes: breathes, shifts her weight L->R->L, looks round (neck leads, head follows), blinks at irregular times (single and double); fingers stir; braid and cape settle after each head turn
graceful in-place walk, 100 steps/min; hips bob and drop, chest counter-turns, arms swing softly with lagging forearms and hands; braid and cape swing
jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm with word gaps; head nods on the stressed syllables; right hand rises palm-up and opens on the beats, closes softly between; weight shift; two blinks
small and scared: shoulders up, chest sunk, head down, hands held together at the chest and wringing; quick glances left and right with holds; nervous weight shifts; frequent blinks

kneeling (upright, on both knees), hands folded at the chest, head bowed; slow deep breathing, a small sway, the folded hands lift a little on each breath. Starts and ends in the kneeling pose: play the extra clip esther_kneel before it for the way down
EXTRA (not in CONTRACT §4): stand -> kneel, right knee first, hands come together; ends in frame 0 of pray

from the kneeling prayer: deep breath, hands part, left foot steps forward, pushes up to standing, feet together, then chin up and chest open, shoulders back, hands close into soft fists at her sides; holds
careful steps up toward the throne: slow, knees lifted high, both hands gather the skirt at the front; leans a little forward, looks down at the step then up at the king
graceful curtsey to the king: small rise and breath (anticipation), right foot slides behind, knees bend, torso and head bow, hands hold the skirt out; holds the low pose (next: touch_sceptre)

rises from the curtsey, takes a small breath, reaches up with the left hand and touches the tip of the king's sceptre (target computed from king_extend_sceptre at the S08 marks), holds it a moment, draws the hand back to her chest, relieved; holds

open-arm invitation: draws in and breathes (anticipation), both arms sweep open, palms up, fingers open, weight forward, head tilt with a smile; settles with the right hand still offering and the left at the chest; holds
accuses: pulls the arm back and turns the chest (anticipation), snaps the right arm out straight at the target, leans in, chin up; small overshoot and settle; left hand a fist at her side; holds
dips, twirls once on her toes (arms out, braid and cape fly out and catch up), dips again, hops with both arms up, lands softly; loops
waves to the viewer: right hand up by her head, forearm sways side to side, the wrist and fingers follow late; body sways and bounces softly on the knees, head tilts; left hand at the waist
seated, heavy: slow deep breathing with one sigh, slow head turns (neck leads), heavy slow blinks; the left hand rests on the knee, fingers drum once; the sceptre stands in the right fist
seated, speaks slowly: deep jaw in an irregular rhythm, nods on the stressed syllables, the left hand lifts from the knee palm-up and opens on the beats; leans in a little
leans in toward the speaker, head tilted, strokes his beard with the left hand, slow 'hmm' nods; slow blinks
careless: leans back with a sigh, then holds out his right hand (ring finger first, the sceptre tilting away) toward Haman and keeps it there; marker release = hand fully out, Haman may take the ring

surprised, leans back a little and breathes in, then leans forward and holds the golden sceptre out to Esther, the knob lowering to her (tip lands at EXTEND_TIP, king-local) with a small overshoot; keeps it
kind and relaxed: leans back a little, warm head tilt, chuckles (shoulders bounce three times), slow nod; left hand open on the knee; slow blinks

rises from the throne in anger: leans forward and grips (anticipation), pushes up and forward onto his feet in front of the seat, chest swells (overshoot), settles into a wide angry stance, fists; holds
standing, furious: big heaving breaths, fists clench and loosen, weight shifts, a snort (head jerk) and a glare that does not leave its target

orders Haman away: pulls the left arm back across the chest (anticipation), flings it out to his left, arm straight, hand flat, head and chest follow; overshoot and hold; the sceptre hand drops to his side
standing, glad and kind: both arms up (sceptre raised high in the right), bounces on his knees, head back laughing, the left hand waves; heavy, not quick
comic and smug: rubs his hands together, bounces up on his toes twice, sly head tilts and glances, blinks (one slow sly one)

proud bouncy walk: chest out, leans back, knees lifted, big hip bounce, arms swing wide and stiff with the hands flopping late, belly first and nose in the air, a snappy stretch-and-squash bounce on each step
EXTRA (timeline S04 asks for haman walk; not in CONTRACT §4): a quick sneaky scurry on tiptoe, hunched forward, knees bent, hands rubbing at the chest, head low and glancing
oily talk: jaw in an irregular rhythm, shrugs and palms-up gestures on the stressed syllables, head waggles, leans in and out
'everyone must bow to me!': crouches and draws his arms in (anticipation), springs up onto his toes and throws his arms wide and up, chest out, chin up; bounces down and holds the pose
sly whisper: leans to his right and forward toward the king, right hand cupped at the side of his mouth, left hand behind his back; jaw murmurs, eyebrows of the sly face; sneaky glances back
greedy snatch: rubs his hands and leans back (anticipation), darts the left hand forward and up and grabs the ring, pulls it to his chest, admires it with a gleeful bounce; holds
arms crossed, chin up, half-lidded eyes, taps his right foot, head bobs to it, nose in the air; one slow self-satisfied nod
caught! freezes for a beat, jumps straight up with arms flung out, the cap pops and slips back askew (marker slip), lands knock-kneed and crouched, hands up; cap stays askew (and in cower / led_away)
crouched and trembling, knees together, hands up in front of his face, peeks out between them and ducks back; cap askew
backward shuffle: crouched, little quick steps backward, hands up, glances back over his shoulder and back to the king; cap askew

exaggerated proud march: belly and chest out, nose in the air, high knees, a snappy bounce on every step (stretch at the top, squash on contact), arms swinging wide and stiff with the hands flopping late, hips and shoulders rolling; the plume whips

admires himself: lifts the ring hand high and gazes at it half-lidded, huffs on the ring, polishes it on his chest in quick circles, tweaks his cap with the other hand, then plants both fists on his hips, belly out (ends in the laugh_proud / smug stance)

fists on hips, head thrown back, belly and shoulders shaking in an uneven 'HA-ha-ha-ha' (bursts that slow and fade, a gasping breath in with the head coming forward, then another burst); the jaw opens with the laugh; squash on every 'ha'

red-faced tantrum: fists shaking by his head, hunched and glaring, four alternating stamps (knee high, slam, whole-body squash, fists pump down; marker stomp = each slam, see markers.stomp.frames), the whole body trembling between them

gloats to the audience: hunched toward the viewer, rubbing his hands fast, head cocked and turned so the eyes slide sideways, shoulders bouncing in uneven giggles (heh-heh-heh ... heh-heh-heh-heh), knees bent

giddy: two skip-hops (on the left foot, then the right, the free knee up, arms pumping), lands with a squash, jabs his thumb into his chest twice, then throws his arms open 'look at me!' up on his toes, chin high; crouches back into the next hop

acts out his own imagined parade: dreamy breath in with clasped hands, sweeps a royal robe up and over his shoulders and fastens it with a shimmy, mimes riding the king's horse (bow-legged gallop, reins jiggling, uneven da-DUM), cups his mouth to shout like a herald, then flings both arms wide and up and holds 'This is the man!' (stunned starts from this pose)

'...Mordecai?!': freezes mid-gesture (arms wide), the jaw drops, the cap pops straight up (marker pop) and drops back with a bounce, the arms go limp and dangle, he totters back on his heels and forward, and ends slumped, jaw hanging, two slow disbelieving blinks; holds

trudging sulk: slouched, head hanging and lolling, feet scuffing low, a heavy drop onto every step; the right arm forward leading the (unseen) horse with a jerk on each step, the left arm dangling; one big shoulder-heaving sigh per loop

standing slouched, the reins in his right hand: breathes in, cups his left hand to his mouth and pushes out a grudging shout (lean in, chest pump, chin up), then deflates in a big sulky slump with a little head shake; about every 2.4 s

on his knees, hands clasped and raised, blubbering: pleading bobs in an uneven please-please-PLEASE (the big one a deep bow with the hands shaken up), head tilted like a wet puppy, sobbing shoulders; shuffles forward on alternating knees (slow locomotion); cap still askew from shock

dragged off backwards by two guards (the director turns him to face away from the travel): upper arms held out and up at the sides at guard-hand height, forearms and hands flailing, legs kicking wildly (L, R, L, then a double thrash) with the heels scraping in front, body leaning back, head thrashing, wailing (terrified face, jaw by the voice); cap askew. naturalSpeed 0.16 = the guards' drag
at attention, spear upright: slow breathing, a stern look round, regrips the spear once, blinks
at attention, spear upright: slow breathing, a stern look round, regrips the spear once, blinks
brisk march: upright, chin up, knees up, crisp heel strikes, inner arm swinging stiff, the spear carried upright and bobbing with the step
brisk march: upright, chin up, knees up, crisp heel strikes, inner arm swinging stiff, the spear carried upright and bobbing with the step
stamps the inner foot, leans in and clamps the inner hand on Haman's upper arm (marker grab; target fitted to the S10 marks, Haman's arm 0.04 in front), tugs back once and holds the grip
stamps the inner foot, leans in and clamps the inner hand on Haman's upper arm (marker grab; target fitted to the S10 marks, Haman's arm 0.04 in front), tugs back once and holds the grip

walks forward leaning into the pull, inner hand on Haman's upper arm at the S10 drag marks (guard1: 0.016 right, 0.046 behind; guard2: 0.011 right, 0.107 in front), a tug on every step; the spear upright in the outer hand. naturalSpeed 0.16 = haman_dragged

walks forward leaning into the pull, inner hand on Haman's upper arm at the S10 drag marks (guard1: 0.016 right, 0.046 behind; guard2: 0.011 right, 0.107 in front), a tug on every step; the spear upright in the outer hand. naturalSpeed 0.16 = haman_dragged
